svg.title: Response and resolution targets — SoftTrack web design mockup (#291)
svg.desc: An urgent ticket from a customer looks the same after four minutes and after four days. A team sets targets by priority for a first response and for resolution, counted in its working hours and paused while waiting on the customer; the card and the ticket say the time left or how long ago the target passed, in words and with an icon.
svg.text: · four minutes and four days, told apart
How long somebody has been waiting

Resolution, by week. Median to first response 41m; to resolution 1 day

svg.text: Done when a team can set a first response and a resolution target per priority, first response is the first public comment by the team and resolution is reaching a done status, the
clock counts the team’s working hours and holiday calendar and pauses in statuses marked as waiting on the customer, the ticket and the card show the time left or passed in
words and with an icon, a warning goes out before the target passes, and a report shows targets met and missed by priority, week and customer.
